title: Wall-slam contradictions — where agents may disagree
policy: Catalog is read-only for this file — observations only, no surgery.
Each item is a place two competent agents can pick opposite homes/actions.
recommend picks one option when prior user ruling or repo policy already settles it.
askUser:true only when ruling is absent, contradictory, or still a named wall.

items.name: Artificer's measure
items.whyAgentsDisagree: User ruling pins a single host (anachronia) with a 4-region required set + UNOBTAINABLE. Catalog and research rows still mirror the 4 pressure regions as hosts. Primary-home agents collapse to 1 host; multi-display agents keep 4 hosts so every pressure region lights up.
items.userRuling: KEEP Artificer's measure on [anachronia] req=[anachronia,forinthry,tirannwn,morytania] UNOBTAINABLE

options.A: Single host anachronia; requiredRegions = [anachronia,forinthry,tirannwn,morytania]; mark UNOBTAINABLE under 3-elective cap. Component map stays anachronia-only pointer.
options.B: Multi-ok hosts = all four pressure regions with the same requiredRegions (planner lights every region in the chain).

items.rationale: Explicit applied ruling already chose single host + multi req + UNOBTAINABLE. Component map was separately single-homed to anachronia.

items.name: Player-owned house portal towns and Construction utilities
items.whyAgentsDisagree: Portal towns are real multi-region geography, but the house instance is not region-owned and all_required on seven regions is planner poison. User KEEP left the multi package; single-home purge explicitly skipped POH portals. Agents split: keep mega multi-ok, primary Rimmington (Asgarnia) with destinations as detail, per-town rows, or remove as pure convenience.
items.userRuling: KEEP Player-owned house portal towns and Construction utilities on [misthalin,karamja,asgarnia,kandarin,fremennik,desert,tirannwn] req=[asgarnia,kandarin,karamja,fremennik,desert,tirannwn,misthalin]

options.A: Keep multi hosts on all portal towns but drop all_required — treat destinations as support pressure / optional detail (not seven hard picks).
options.B: Primary-only asgarnia (Rimmington Construction default); list other portal towns only in detail.
options.C: Global remove as non-upgrade travel convenience; Construction depth lives on other rows.

items.question: POH portals: multi hosts with pressure-only (not all_required), primary Asgarnia/Rimmington only, or remove the package entirely?

items.whyAgentsDisagree: Intentionally multi-source (scales / ancient scales / thread; not a clean single-region lock). Host set includes kandarin while requiredRegions is forinthry+morytania — host/req drift invites primary-forinthry, multi-ok forinthry+morytania, or material-pressure multi including kandarin.
items.userRuling: user_ruling_sirenic_wall — do not fake single primary without human call

options.A: Multi-ok forinthry+morytania only (scale/thread pressure); drop kandarin host or demote to detail.
options.B: Multi-ok including kandarin (shop/surface pressure) with requiredRegions expanded or left pressure-only.
options.C: Primary single host (choose forinthry or morytania) + support detail only.

items.question: Sirenic T90: multi-ok forinthry+morytania only, add kandarin, or primary-only (which home) with others as detail?

items.userRuling: user_ruling_sirenic_wall

options.B: Demote to support-pressure notes under base Sirenic only; no separate elite row multi-host.

items.question: Elite sirenic: multi-ok forinthry+tirannwn, demote under base sirenic, or UNOBTAINABLE package?

items.name: Rings of Rasial / Occultist vs densify triad
items.whyAgentsDisagree: Necromancy boss package (Rasial, First Necromancer gear) is Misthalin-single. Occultist's ring is Anachronia-only (heart densify) while Reaver's / Stalker's / Channeller's are dual anachronia+fremennik. Agents may (1) move Occultist onto Misthalin with Rasial BiS, (2) force Occultist onto the same dual densify pattern as the triad, (3) invent missing Ring of death / Champion's ring hosts, or (4) leave taxonomy split.

options.A: Keep split: Rasial boss/gear Misthalin-only; Occultist anachronia heart densify; Reaver/Stalker/Channeller multi-ok anachronia+fremennik. Do not invent Ring of death until a sourced residual exists.
options.B: Unify all densify-style combat rings as multi-ok anachronia+fremennik (pull Occultist into the dual) and park any Rasial-drop rings under Misthalin separately.

items.rationale: Catalog already encodes the split; no user ruling demands collapsing Occultist into Rasial geography. Adding missing rings is a data-fill task, not a host fight.
